steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Accepted outputs, coordination failures, wall-clock time, and total cost across all agents.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation
summary: Boundary-Aware Policy Learning replaces ad hoc agent-to-policy invocation, in which a visuomotor policy is called from states outside its reliable start region, with explicit shaping of a 'handoff boundary' via fine-tuning on diverse-start contact segments plus retraining on curated successful rollouts. The cost is a two-stage policy training pipeline on robot demonstration data (RoboTwin 2.0, RoboDojo) and maintenance of a handoff protocol the agent must follow, plus compute for iterative self-improvement retraining. The method can fail when deployment tasks or embodiments differ from training distributions, and its gains are validated only in simulation benchmarks rather than on physical hardware.
rationale: The technique addresses handoff reliability between a multimodal agent and learned visuomotor policies in physical robot manipulation, a domain outside the reader's LLM production scope and requiring robotics simulation infrastructure and policy training.
technique: Boundary-aware handoff training for agent-orchestrated robot policies
